verdict.rationale:
A probe confirms Stripe serves a working llms.txt (HTTP 200) with agent-oriented guidance, and .md documentation pages are directly fetchable (docs.stripe.com/payments.md, checkout.md, etc.), exactly the pattern this story asks for. This is reinforced by dedicated agent-facing docs (agents.md, mcp.md) and a GitHub 'agent skills' repo (stripe/ai) built specifically for coding/AI agents to consult best practices.
Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation from a third party that an agent successfully used llms.txt end-to-end, and no llms-full.txt or sitemap-style index evidenced.
